extracted.name: Roasted celeriac & carrots with kale & hazelnuts
extracted.description: Enjoy this colourful side with your Christmas dinner. It combines roasted celeriac, carrots, kale and hazelnuts in a vinegar dressing
ingredient_lines: 1 celeriac peeled and cut into chunky chips or wedges
4 large carrots cut into chunky chips or wedges
instruction_lines: Heat the oven to 220C/200C fan/gas 7. Heat the butter and half the oil in a large roasting tin in the oven until foaming. Toss in the celeriac and carrots. Season. Roast for 40-50 mins, stirring occasionally until the veg is golden and soft.
Add the rest of the oil, the nuts and kale, and bake for 15 mins until the kale has wilted and is crisp at the edges. Toss with the vinegar.
